entries.title: Fourier entropy-influence conjecture: exact uniform Boolean scope
entries.statement: CONJECTURE: there exists a finite universal C such that for every n and every f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, with fhat(S)=E[f(X) product_{j in S} X_j] under uniform independent signs, H_2(f)=sum_{S subset [n]} fhat(S)^2 log_2(1/fhat(S)^2) <= C I(f), where I(f)=sum_S |S| fhat(S)^2 and zero summands are zero. The dated intake P0162 ranking is historical; current global openness was not certified by w505.

entries.title: Boolean Fourier entropy restriction deficit
entries.statement: For f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, normalized uniform Walsh coefficients and base-2 Fourier spectral entropy H_2(f), define f_+ and f_- by fixing coordinate i to +1 and -1, and Delta_i(f)=H_2(f)-(H_2(f_+)+H_2(f_-))/2. The coordinate influence is I_i(f)=sum_{S containing i} fhat(S)^2. The deficit ratio Delta_i/I_i is defined only when I_i>0.

entries.title: Draft obstruction to all-coordinate FEI restriction induction
entries.statement: DRAFT, pending independent referee check: for m>=1, N=2^(2m), u,v in F_2^m, y in {-1,+1}, let F_m(u,v,y)=(-1)^(u dot v)-(1-y)1{u=v=0}, with uniform inputs. This is Boolean. An independent calculation in w505/ATTEMPT.md gives I_y=1/N and Delta_y/I_y>=log_2((2^m-1)^2+1), which is unbounded, while the same family has H_2(F_m)<=2 I(F_m). It challenges an all-coordinate restriction-deficit bound; it does not challenge the FEI target or establish a new full theorem. Earlier owner F4 work already records related failed coordinate rules. Finite checks corroborate the calculation; they are not a referee keep.

entries.title: Unproved suitable-coordinate input for full FEI
entries.statement: UNPROVED INPUT: a universal finite C such that every nonconstant Boolean uniform-cube function has some positive-influence coordinate i satisfying Delta_i(f)<=C I_i(f), with the same C for all dimensions and all restrictions. Together with I(f)=I_i(f)+(I(f_+)+I(f_-))/2, it would prove FEI by induction from constants. The all-coordinate strengthening fails in the draft explicit witness; choosing a coordinate of maximal influence is not justified by this packet and prior owner work reports it fails. The missing work is a valid coordinate choice or a noncircular structural estimate in the small-influence regime.
assumptions: same universal C at every inductive step

relations.rationale: The witness uses exactly the defined Delta_y and I_y, with base-2 uniform Fourier normalization.
The unproved local input quantifies over Delta_i/I_i as defined, not H/I.
The exact influence recursion makes the clearly unproved local coordinate premise sufficient for the stated full FEI target.
